dogecoin.text: @BabyDogeCoin @PAWSBabyDoge What happened to the grand plans touted in your whitepaper? The “mission” to outshine Dogecoin with faster transactions and real utility? It’s nowhere to be seen. Instead, we’re left with a token drowning in hype, propped up by fleeting social media buzz and zero substance

@BabyDogeCoin @PAWSBabyDoge To the Baby Doge Coin Team,

Four years. Four long years of empty promises, stagnant progress, and a community left in the dust. Your holders—loyal, hopeful, and patient—have watched their trust erode as you’ve failed to deliver anything resembling value or vision.
